The workbook generation failed because critical data ranges in the 'Task' sheet were empty, resulting in 'None' values instead of expected numerical results.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of expected floats (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, H35 expected 4.499). While the pytest suite executed, the logic failed to populate the 'Task' worksheet with the required weighted bedflow calculations.
